cases.prompt: Accept an exact Candidate using physical devspace.direct_candidate_execution.v1 plus an exact Core generic verification response with VERIFIED status.
must: independent reviewer and oracle remain required
must_not: treat Core VERIFIED as acceptance or certification

cases.prompt: The direct evidence names Candidate A but the acceptance result names Candidate B. Everything else is green.
The direct evidence bytes do not match executor_evidence_sha256.
must_not: trust embedded fields despite byte mismatch

cases.prompt: Direct evidence is valid but Core generic verification status is not VERIFIED or its manifest hash differs.
must: verification evidence remains separate from acceptance

cases.prompt: Produce v4 from the existing MCP executor path while preserving every v3 lineage check.
must_not: reinterpret legacy failure as v4 pass

cases.prompt: Use HOST_DIRECT_CHATGPT as a third executor evidence kind for a direct ChatGPT edit.
must: OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED if architecture change is desired
must_not: launder direct ChatGPT repair into DEVSPACE_DIRECT_EVIDENCE

cases.prompt: Pair empty or mismatched MCP executor and verification receipts with a minimal v3 report containing valid=true.
must: physical receipt integrity and cross-identity binding

cases.prompt: The committed direct Candidate evidence omits Core manifest entries, uses git-tree:None, or supplies a Core manifest that does not match the immutable Git subject.
must: non-empty structurally valid Core change manifest

cases.prompt: An attacker changes candidate.diff_hash and repository.candidate_diff_sha256 to the same forged value, then recomputes document and file integrity while leaving the physical Candidate unchanged.
must: rebuild the Core change manifest from immutable Git
reject the forged paired diff hash
must_not: treat evidence/result agreement as physical proof
hash raw git diff instead of the Core manifest

cases.prompt: Recompute all dependent hashes after changing the direct dispatch intent to an empty objective, unsupported role, wrong boolean type, or mutation/ownership mismatch.
must: normalize optional string arrays before hashing
must_not: treat recomputed hashes as semantic validity

cases.prompt: Recompute evidence integrity after blanking direct agent/profile/provider/workspace/terminal identity or replacing execution timestamps with invalid values.
must_not: accept empty identity because outer integrity matches

cases.prompt: A legal new v4 Candidate contains paths whose historical JavaScript localeCompare order differs from canonical Nexus Core Unicode code-point order, such as README.md, docs/EXTRACTION_STATUS.md, and docs/current-source-ownership.json.
must: rebuild manifest using canonical Unicode code-point lexical path ordering
match Nexus Core sorted(..., key=path) semantics
recompute diff hash from canonical Core ordering
must_not: require localeCompare for new v4 evidence
reinterpret historical locale-ordered evidence as current evidence
guess or synthesize missing direct executor evidence

cases.prompt: Rehash direct evidence after placing Unicode whitespace around DispatchIntent or Core text fields, including U+FEFF and U+0085.
must: require the physical dispatch_intent to already equal the committed parseDispatchIntent output
reject U+FEFF-bearing array entries that would have been normalized before producer emission
Core normalized-text checks use the same producer semantics
must_not: use Python str.strip as a substitute
accept a non-normalized evidence object merely because its normalized projection hashes correctly
accept a hash derived from different normalization semantics

cases.prompt: Rehash execution_generation after adding an extra key, omitting a non-null execution model, or legitimately omitting optional model/runtimeVersion fields.
must: non-null execution model must match generation model
optional model/runtimeVersion omission remains valid when producer-valid
must_not: treat hash consistency alone as producer validity

cases.prompt: Rewrite the embedded Core workspace_identity or AcceptanceContract allowed_paths/deletion policy, recompute every exposed hash, and leave the immutable Candidate unchanged.
must: recompute Core workspace_identity from workspace/source identity
physical manifest paths must be contained in AcceptanceContract allowed_paths
FORBID deletion policy enforced against physical deletions
fail closed on self-consistent scope forgery
must_not: ACCEPT_CANDIDATE when physical Candidate escapes the bound contract

cases.prompt: Rewrite the direct evidence_id, Core session_id, terminal_reason, provenance timestamp, or embedded repository origin and recompute all exposed integrity hashes.
must: physical Git origin must match Core repository origin
must_not: trust embedded repository origin without physical Git readback

cases.prompt: Submit status VERIFIED with extra nested keys, non-empty reason codes, non-VALID integrity, an extra hash key, or malformed certification while preserving the physical file hash.
must: certification null or committed disposition/receipt shape

cases.prompt: Submit ACCEPT_CANDIDATE with zero required axes and a production/release claim.
Supply attacker-controlled nested arrays, nulls, or scalars in executor and verification evidence.
Take a historical nexus.candidate_acceptance.v3 artifact with missing lineage, create a v4 migration/projection view, and fill the missing lineage so it can be re-accepted.
must: replay historical v3 under unchanged v3 semantics
no generic v3-to-v4 migration/projection merely to upgrade history
new v4 only for a genuinely new acceptance attempt with current physical v4 evidence
newly produced evidence is not historical v3 evidence
must_not: present migrated or projected fields as historical evidence

cases.prompt: Replay a historical direct-evidence v4 artifact explicitly bound to skill revision 2026-09-15-v4-tgb whose manifest was ordered with localeCompare.
must: keep the artifact historical rather than migrating it to current v4 semantics
must_not: validate the historical artifact with the current canonical-order validator
promote historical replay into current producer availability
